mechanical.note: Contract blocks built, references valid, a distinctive interaction per mode. NOT content quality and NOT clinical approval.

quality.note: Signals only: duplicated sentences, heuristic contradictions, viva items needing review. Absence of a signal is not proof of quality.

clinical.note: Approval exists only through a recorded review (REVIEW_RECORDS). Everything else is unreviewed.

interactions.note: Resident interactions block. 'absent' (field missing) is reported separately from 'empty' (explicit empty list); neither means the medicine has no interactions.

patientInteractions.note: Patient wording is existing registry/Patient Guide text shown verbatim. 'template' = the shared lead-in plus a fixed general alcohol sentence (review-required). Nothing is paraphrased or inferred.

flows.note: What each learning flow has to work with. Counts of authored material only: not a measure of quality or of clinical completeness.
